People qualified to make decisions about abortion: health care providers, patients.

People unqualified: politicians, judges.

I am proud to fight with @ReproCaucus to restore, expand, and protect reproductive freedom as we reflect on this 52nd #RoevWade anniversary.

At a time when Republicans are attacking science, slashing health care, and putting politics over patients, Democratic physicians must be organized to fight back. This week, we launched the Congressional Doctors Caucus to champion patient-centered, science-based policy. We will be vigilant, push back against dangerous misinformation, and fight for every American’s right to have meaningful access to high-quality, affordable health care.

The Democratic Doctors Caucus is standing together to deliver one, unified message: Hands off Medicaid. As physicians, we are not just fighting for our patients—we’re fighting for every American’s health care. https://t.co/BRQ1Nosn4z

More than half of Planned Parenthood’s 2+ million patients nationwide rely on Medicaid for wellness checks, cancer screenings, and more.

Dear Speaker Johnson, Planned Parenthood is more popular than you. Hands off our health care.

Cuts to Medicaid means:

Fewer doctors.
Fewer hospitals.
Fewer community health clinics.
Fewer healthy people.

All for what? More tax breaks for billionaires. The cruelty is the point.

I heard it directly from healthcare leaders in my district: Republicans’ brutal budget bill will lead to closures of hospitals and less access to life-saving care. More Oregonians will die preventable deaths if this bill passes, and I will fight like hell to keep that from happening.

As a physician who cared for patients in Oregon, I know exactly what cuts to Medicaid will mean: neighbors forced to go without care, crowded ERs, hospital closures, clinicians pushed past their limits. 

The quality of health care in our state will decline for every single person.

Senate Republicans voted to:

- Rip health care away from your neighbors
- Close hospitals & nursing homes in every community
- Cut food assistance for kids
- Raise energy costs
 
For what? To give tax breaks to billionaires. Trump calls this “beautiful”—I call it a betrayal. I'll fight back in the House.
EMTALA, the federal law requiring hospitals to provide emergency care, still applies to emergency abortion care—no matter what Trump says. https://t.co/2Xm4pEE8wI

Big Pharma’s marketing machine misleads patients and drives up costs. Today, we’re introducing the House companion to @SenSanders’s End Prescription Drug Ads Now Act to put a stop to these ads once and for all. https://t.co/aEeunqtIzV

Eight months into my term as a U.S. Representative, I understand a simple truth: you can’t legislate from behind a desk. To make informed, effective policy on wildfire preparedness, forest health, and public lands, you must walk the land, sometimes stumble over its roots, and hear directly from those doing the hard work on the ground.

That’s why I’m backpacking 40 miles around Mt. Hood. Over this four-day trek, I’ll meet with Tribal leaders, conservationists, and policy partners to build durable policies that protect Mt. Hood—and all our treasured places—for generations to come.

I stand with the more than 1,000 Health and Human Services workers putting the health and safety of the American people first. RFK Jr.: resign now.

He is a danger to our country. https://t.co/09MxUdufif
The West Coast Health Alliance will guarantee our constituents' health is driven by science and data, not politics. Our communities deserve nothing less.
RFK Jr. must go. Dangerous. Incompetent. A public health disaster. https://t.co/StOA7UZ0Au
Public health pro tip from the only pulmonologist in Congress: you don’t fight air pollution by hiding the numbers.

Good policy starts with good data. On the House Natural Resources Committee, I'm pushing to get the data necessary to protect the health and safety of the firefighters at the forefront of wildfires ravaging our states. https://t.co/MlONdWVTHq

Trump is quietly launching a pilot program to restrict even more Americans’ access to health care. This time, he’s coming for Medicare—the health care for Americans 65 and older. Here’s how:
https://t.co/dBlXZTiMh6

3/
Under the pilot program, Medicare will contract with private companies to impose prior authorization for certain services. That means doctors will now need approval from outside contractors before treating some of their patients’ conditions.

4/
These contractors will be paid more when they reduce spending—a built-in profit incentive to delay or deny care. Replacing clinicians’ medical knowledge with an algorithm designed to maximize profits. It’s sick and twisted.

Children in Gaza are wasting away. Malnutrition isn’t just hunger. It permanently scars a child's brain and body. I am calling on Trump to ensure unhindered humanitarian access into Gaza. https://t.co/lcIop99nFa

Health care premiums are set to spike for millions if Congress lets enhanced subsidies expire. I’m fighting to extend them and keep coverage affordable for Oregonians. Extend the subsidies now. https://t.co/AVw6Bie1iv

There are just 11 days left until a government shutdown.

The question is simple:

Will congressional Republicans work with Democrats to protect working families?
Or will they continue driving up costs and slashing health care for the very communities they represent?

I'll work with anyone to make lives better for Oregonians.

RFK Jr. has corrupted vaccine guidance. The West Coast Health Alliance is filling the void with recommendations based in science, not politics. Our communities deserve nothing less. And as physicians, we’ll always tell you: check with your own trusted provider for what’s right for you.

Trust doctors, not politicians for health advice! Physicians spend their entire careers reviewing the available science to make informed recommendations to patients. RFK Jr.’s rhetoric about people with autism is not just unscientific—it is dangerous. As the federal government is twisted into a conduit for misinformation, I encourage you to turn to your own trusted provider for what’s right for you. Real healthcare is based in science, not politics.

1/ Over the next few days, you’ll hear a lot about rising healthcare premiums. As one of only six Democratic physicians in Congress, I’m here to break down what’s happening—and why it matters for you.
